fields.label: Proofpoint Portal host
fields.description: Full API host, same as your Proofpoint Portal URL — e.g. yourcompany.tessian-platform.com (EU) or yourcompany.tessian-app.com (US). No scheme or path.

fields.label: API token
fields.description: Proofpoint API token, generated in the Proofpoint Portal under Integrations -> Security Integrations -> Proofpoint API. Injected server-side as the Authorization header.
